tbl_description: One row per Niskin bottle water sample (position, depth, time, cast and bottle number), CalCOFI-CCE cruises 2004-2023. Exact duplicates dropped; samples with no or conflicting depth held out (Q02, Q04).
Particulate organic carbon (poc) and nitrogen (pon) in umol/L, long format (one row per sample x measurement_type).
